description: This file defines the NotesController class, which provides REST API endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting note entities within the application. It handles HTTP POST, GET, and DELETE requests related to notes, interacting with the database context and managing audit actions.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: A controller class for managing note entities via REST API endpoints.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: HTTP POST method to create a new note, associating it with the current user.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: HTTP GET method to retrieve a list of notes filtered by parent type and ID.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: HTTP DELETE method to delete a note by its ID, with audit logging.
